title: 第23章 匠气太重第24章 轻易过关
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
自家族大比后，五长老数次邀请沈云去飘渺峰修行。
“主脉不能随便进出，待在那没有自由，还是落云峰更适合我。”
沈云直接拒绝了，气的五长老吹胡子瞪眼。
大长老也亲自寻来，见沈云的态度很坚持，他退而求其次，许诺了诸多资源。
“从今以后，你每个月的资源翻三倍，藏经阁三层以下可以随意翻阅。”
沈云当即道：“多谢大长老。”
这次没有一人反对，沈云的表现已经得到了一致认可。
只有三长老有些忧虑，“这么好的苗子，放任自流我怕会长歪了。”
大长老挥了挥手，正色道：“沈云是真正的天才，指手画脚对他只是束缚，我们能做的就是全力支持他。”
听闻此言，他们才明白大长老有多么看好沈云，再无一人出言置喙。
连雨不觉春去，一晴方觉夏深。
转眼已是三月过去，沈云在家门口的竹林纳凉。
清风徐徐，竹叶萧萧。
围棋石桌前，沈云和沈武德正在对弈，后者眼珠子一转，装模作样的伸了个懒腰。
啪的一声，棋盒被打翻，和石桌上的棋子混在一起。
“抱歉大哥，我不是故意的。”
沈武德连连道歉，眼中却满是笑意，‘好险，差点又输了三十灵石。
沈云暼了他一眼，变魔术般拿出留影石，轻笑道：“没关系，我正好留了记录。”
沈武德嘴角一抽，眼睁睁看着棋盘恢复原状，郁闷道：“这局我输了。”
他心不甘情不愿的掏出三十灵石，递给沈云的时候心中如同滴血。

沈云毫不客气的笑纳了，轻笑道：“还继续不？”
沈武德将头摇的像拨浪鼓，心中暗自发誓再也不和沈云死磕了。
围棋已经是他俩较量的第十个项目，不论是象棋、牌九、骰子…刚开始的时候沈云都好像新手，让他吃到点甜头。
然而最多三把，他就毫无招架之力，被杀的片甲不留。
‘他不会是在钓我的鱼吧，胖爷纵横江湖二十年，今天算是认栽了。
沈武德彻底服气，人已经输麻了，于是准备去坊市开始老本行。
沈云起身道：“一起吧，正好我也想去去卖点灵符。”
沈武德双眼一亮，搓手道：“大哥竟然还是灵符师，直接卖给小弟就行了，价格童叟无欺。”
最近坑了几个肥羊，他正好要去补充货源。
沈云倒是无所谓，随手将一沓灵符递过去，却发现他的面色很是嫌弃。
“咋尽是些精品灵符，有没有便宜点的。”
沈武德挑三拣四，最后郁闷的将灵符还了回去。
content_en:
Since the family competition, the Fifth Elder invited Shen Yun several times to practice at Piaomiao Peak.
"The main vein cannot come in and out at will. There is no freedom to stay there. Luoyun Peak is more suitable for me."
Shen Yun refused directly, and the fifth elder was so angry that he blew his beard and stared.
The Great Elder also personally came to find him. Seeing Shen Yun's insistence, he settled for the next best thing and promised many resources.
"From now on, your monthly resources will be tripled, and you can browse at will below the third floor of the Sutra Pavilion."
Shen Yun immediately said: "Thank you, Great Elder."
This time no one objected, and Shen Yun's performance had been unanimously recognized.
Only the third elder was a little worried, "Such a good seedling, I'm afraid it will grow crooked if left to its own devices."
The Great Elder waved his hand and said sternly: "Chen Yun is a true genius. Pointing fingers at him is just a constraint. All we can do is fully support him."
After hearing this, they realized how much the great elder thought highly of Shen Yun, and no one said anything.
It rains continuously and I don’t realize that spring is gone, but when it clears up, I realize that summer is deep.
March has passed in the blink of an eye, and Shen Yun is enjoying the cool air in the bamboo forest in front of his home.
The breeze blows slowly and the bamboo leaves rustle.
In front of the Go stone table, Shen Yun and Shen Wude were playing chess. The latter rolled his eyes and pretended to stretch.
With a bang, the chess box was knocked over and mixed with the chess pieces on the stone table.
"Sorry brother, I didn't mean it."
Shen Wude apologized repeatedly, but his eyes were full of smiles, "What a risk, I almost lost another thirty spiritual stones."
Shen Yunxian glanced at him, took out the photo stone like magic, and chuckled: "It doesn't matter, I just kept a record."
Shen Wude twitched the corner of his mouth, watched helplessly as the chessboard returned to its original state, and said depressedly: "I lost this game."
He reluctantly took out thirty spiritual stones and handed them to Shen Yun as if his heart was bleeding.
Chen Yun accepted the offer without politeness and chuckled, "Do you want to continue?"
Shen Wude shook his head like a rattle and secretly vowed never to fight with Shen Yun again.
Go is already the tenth event that they have competed in. Whether it is chess, Pai Gow, or dice... Shen Yun seemed like a novice at the beginning, which gave him some advantages.
However, at most three attacks, he was unable to resist, and no one was left alive.
‘He’s not trying to catch my fish, right? The fat man has been in the world for twenty years, and today he admits his defeat.
Shen Wude was completely convinced and was already losing money, so he was ready to go to Fangshi to start his own business.
Chen Yun stood up and said, "Let's go together. I just want to go and sell some magic talismans."
Shen Wude's eyes lit up, he rubbed his hands and said, "The eldest brother is actually a spiritual talisman master. Just sell it to the younger brother directly. The price is reasonable."
A few fat sheep have been cheated recently, and he happened to be going to replenish his supply.
Chen Yun didn't care, and casually handed over a bunch of spiritual talismans, but found that his expression was very disgusting.
"These are some fine talismans. Are there any cheaper ones?"
Shen Wude was picky and finally returned the talisman in frustration.
